datasets.title: Mount Agung Update - Bali, Indonesia
datasets.description: On 22 September 2017 at 20.30 hrs. Indonesia's Centre of Volcanology and Geological Hazard Mitigation (PVMBG) increased the status of Mt. Agung in Karangasem District, Bali Province from Level 3 (High Alert) to Level 4 (Danger), the highest level for a volcano. And on 29 October 2017, at 16.00 hrs, the status of Mt. Agung has been lowered from Level IV (dangerous) to Level III (alert). The no activity zone has also been reduced from 9 Km radius with additional sectoral expansion of 12km north-northwest and south-southwest become 6 km radius from the volcano with additional sectoral expansion of 7.5 km north-northwest and south-southwest. The displaced people who lived outside of the no activity zone start to return back home but advised to remain cautious.. [Source: This metadata record was automatically extracted from the Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX); Original dataset: https://data.humdata.org/dataset/mount-agung-update-bali-indonesia]

entity.name: Indonesia's Centre of Volcanology and Geological Hazard Mitigation (PVMBG)

lineage.description: Volcanic hazard data derived from real-time observational monitoring by PVMBG, with alert status classifications (Level 3-4) and exclusion zone radius determinations updated based on visual observations of volcanic activity. Data triangulated and disseminated by Indonesia's disaster management agency (BNPB) to inform evacuation and risk management decisions.

sources.description: Official volcanic monitoring and alert status assessments for Mount Agung, including alert level classifications and exclusion zone radius determinations based on visual observation and geological monitoring.

sources.description: Disaster management agency providing triangulated estimates and situational updates on volcanic hazard status and mitigation measures.

resources.title: Mt_Agung
resources.description: Data as of September 26, 2017. The dataset contains number of evacuation sites per district and estimated population of evacuees in 9 Districts at Bali province. The dataset is updated regularly. The source is Indonesia National Disaster management Agency (BNPB).
